headline: Hezbollah denies Yemeni transitional council claim that IRGC + Hezbollah experts run Ansar Allah operations
dek: Hezbollah 'categorically denies' a presence of Hezbollah experts in Yemen or participation in managing Ansar Allah military operations and developing armament/training capabilities, calling the accusations 'completely baseless'; it says Yemenis possess the capabilities to defend themselves and that…
sources: Hezbollah media relations office statement, via AJ liveblog; responding to Yemeni transitional council interior minister Ibrahim Ali Haidan's claim of 21 foreign experts (14 IRGC + 7 Hezbollah)
fault_line: Foreign hands or Yemeni war? The fault line is whether the Yemen war is run by Tehran/Hezbollah experts or by Yemenis themselves — both sides now have an on-record position.

sections.what_happened: Hezbollah 'categorically denies' a presence of Hezbollah experts in Yemen or participation in managing Ansar Allah military operations and developing armament/training capabilities, calling the accusations 'completely baseless'; it says Yemenis possess the capabilities to defend themselves and that Yemeni dialogue is the only way to preserve unity and stability.
sections.what_verified: AJ liveblog carrying the Hezbollah statement; the underlying claim (Haidan) was previously triaged as single-side and unconfirmed — the denial does not verify or falsify it
sections.what_disputed: Haidan's 21-experts claim (14 IRGC + 7 Hezbollah) has no independent evidence in the material checked; neither the claim nor the denial is independently confirmed as to facts on the ground. Ansar Allah (Ansar Allah) have not been quoted on this exchange in-window.
sections.why_matters: Use only as the counterpoint beat inside a Yemen item: claim vs denial, both attributed, neither proven. Never publish the 21-experts claim alone as fact.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 11:45 GMT = 15:45 ): Hezbollah denies Yemeni transitional council claim that IRGC + Hezbollah experts run Ansar Allah operations

totw_analysis: Our read: Use only as the counterpoint beat inside a Yemen item: claim vs denial, both attributed, neither proven. Never publish the 21-experts claim alone as fact.
